acronym.pick: What is the common acronym for {label}?
acronym.match: Match each organization to its acronym.
acronym.reverse: Which organization goes by the acronym {value}?

country.match: Match each organization to the country it is headquartered in.

rows.label: United Nations
rows.description: global international and intergovernmental organization
rows.hook: brings countries together in a General Assembly and a Security Council to keep the peace

rows.label: Major League Soccer
rows.description: professional soccer league in the USA and Canada
rows.hook: is the top professional circuit where clubs like Inter Miami and the LA Galaxy compete

rows.label: Canadian Broadcasting Corporation
rows.description: Canadian public broadcaster
rows.hook: is the public radio and television network behind Hockey Night

rows.label: Union of European Football Associations
rows.description: international governing body for association football in Europe
rows.hook: runs the Champions League and the continental championship for clubs and national teams

rows.label: International Criminal Court
rows.description: intergovernmental organization and international tribunal
rows.hook: sits in The Hague and tries individuals for war crimes and genocide

rows.label: Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development
rows.description: intergovernmental economic organization
rows.hook: is a Paris-based club of wealthy, market-driven nations that publishes influential statistics

rows.label: Amazon Web Services
rows.description: subsidiary of Amazon that provides on-demand cloud computing platforms on a metered pay-as-you-go basis
rows.hook: is the cloud computing arm of the online retail giant, hosting much of the internet

rows.label: World Health Organization
rows.description: United Nations agency concerned with international public health
rows.hook: is the UN agency that leads global responses to pandemics and declared COVID-19 a pandemic

rows.label: National Collegiate Athletic Association
rows.description: American collegiate athletic organization
rows.hook: governs college sports and runs the March Madness basketball tournament

rows.label: Associated Press
rows.description: multinational nonprofit news agency headquartered in New York, United States
rows.hook: is a nonprofit news agency whose stylebook is followed by newsrooms across the country

rows.label: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
rows.description: international organization of petroleum-exporting countries
rows.hook: is a cartel of oil-producing nations that sets production quotas to influence crude prices

rows.label: United States Postal Service
rows.description: independent agency of the U.S. federal government responsible for providing postal service
rows.hook: delivers letters and packages to every address, with its carriers famously braving snow, rain and heat

rows.label: African Union
rows.description: supranational union in Africa
rows.hook: unites the member states of an entire continent and has its headquarters in Addis Ababa

rows.label: New Japan Pro-Wrestling
rows.description: Japanese professional wrestling promotion
rows.hook: is the biggest grappling promotion in its home country, home to the Tokyo Dome show Wrestle Kingdom

rows.label: World Economic Forum
rows.description: Swiss nonprofit foundation
rows.hook: hosts an annual meeting of business and world leaders in the Alpine ski town of Davos

rows.label: World Trade Organization
rows.description: intergovernmental organization that intends to supervise and liberalize international trade
rows.hook: sets the rules for commerce between nations and settles disputes over tariffs

rows.label: Recording Industry Association of America
rows.description: trade organization representing the recording industry in the United States of America
rows.hook: certifies albums Gold and Platinum based on how many copies they sell

rows.label: World Championship Wrestling
rows.description: American professional wrestling company
rows.hook: was the rival that battled the WWF in the Monday Night Wars, home of the nWo

rows.label: Internet Engineering Task Force
rows.description: Open Internet standards organization
rows.hook: develops the technical rules that make the web work, publishing them as numbered RFC documents

rows.label: Internal Revenue Service
rows.description: revenue service of the United States federal government
rows.hook: collects federal taxes and is the agency everyone files a return with every April

rows.label: European Space Agency
rows.description: European organisation dedicated to space exploration
rows.hook: is a multinational body that launches rockets from French Guiana and sent the Rosetta probe to a comet

rows.label: International Olympic Committee
rows.description: non-governmental sports organisation (founded 1894)
rows.hook: organizes the Summer and Winter Games and awards gold, silver and bronze medals

rows.label: Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation
rows.description: international economic forum
rows.hook: is a forum where Rim leaders meet each year to discuss commerce, often in matching shirts

rows.label: American Chemical Society
rows.description: professional society, publisher
rows.hook: is a scientific group that publishes journals and assigns the registry numbers for substances

rows.label: European Free Trade Association
rows.description: international trade organization and free trade area
rows.hook: is a bloc of countries such as Norway and Iceland that chose not to join the EU

rows.label: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers
rows.description: American professional association for electronic engineering and electrical engineering
rows.hook: is the professional body that sets standards for Wi-Fi and Ethernet networking

rows.label: American Film Institute
rows.description: American nonprofit educational arts organization devoted to film
rows.hook: publishes a famous list ranking the greatest movies ever made and gives a lifetime achievement award

rows.label: Organization of American States
rows.description: international organization of states in the Americas
rows.hook: is a body linking nations of North and South America and the Caribbean, headquartered in Washington, D.C

rows.label: Extreme Championship Wrestling
rows.description: defunct American professional wrestling promotion
rows.hook: was a Philadelphia-based promotion known for hardcore matches with tables and barbed wire

rows.label: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory
rows.description: federal research institute in Livermore, California, United States
rows.hook: is a US science lab where researchers first got more energy out of a fusion reaction than the lasers put in

rows.label: National Institute of Standards and Technology
rows.description: measurement standards laboratory in the United States
rows.hook: keeps the official measures for weights and time, and helps set encryption benchmarks

rows.label: International Civil Aviation Organization
rows.description: specialized agency of the United Nations, coordinates the international civil aviation regulations and policy
rows.hook: is the UN agency that sets worldwide rules for airline safety and air travel

rows.label: Oxford University Press
rows.description: publishing arm of the University of Oxford
rows.hook: is a college-owned publisher known for its famous English dictionary
